k.place: Picket post on the Chambersburg Pike at Knoxlyn Road, about 3 miles west of Gettysburg
k.cb: Marker or tablet site coordinates (Historical Marker Database)
k.say: Marker: "First shot / Gettysburg / July 1st 1863 / 7:30 a.m."
k.notes: Company E, Lt. Marcellus Jones. Time rests on a marker placed in 1886 by the participants. S02 has the enemy approaching the pickets "about 3 miles distant".

k.place: In camp at the Lutheran seminary building, Seminary Ridge
k.cb: Estimated by Claude from the place description; not measured on a map
k.say: "while in camp at the seminary building"

k.place: McPherson Ridge: right resting on the railroad bed, left near the Fairfield (Hagerstown) road
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. lat/lon = right flank (3rd Indiana, north of the railroad bed); line_end = left flank (8th New York).
k.say: S02: "placed in line of battle about 1 mile in front of the seminary", "the right resting on the railroad track and the left near the Middletown or Fairfax [Fairfield] road"
k.notes: Regiment order within the line is not given. "About 1 mile" from the seminary would reach Willoughby Run; the tablet and S15 put the line on McPherson Ridge (see Conflicts). Map check: the four regiments are drawn (labels "Morning" and "9 A.M.") on the eastern arm of McPherson Ridge, about 540 m (0.34 mile) in front of the seminary and about 300 m behind Calef's guns on the pike. That is much closer in than Gamble's "about 1 mile". See C05.

k.act: Fall back, relieved by First Corps
k.place: About 200 yards behind the first line, on the next ridge east
k.cb: No coordinates in v2: the v1 point falls on the line the map draws for the morning position (P04), so it no longer shows a fall-back. The fall-back line is not drawn on the map.
k.say: S02: "compelled to fall back about 200 yards to the next ridge". S01: "dragged back a few hundred yards"
k.notes: Position is stated; the time is not. S01 says the brigade held "for more than two hours"; S02 says "several hours".

k.place: Three squadrons sent forward as skirmishers to support the picket squadron; fighting back along the pike from Knoxlyn Road toward Herr Ridge
k.cb: Estimated by Claude from the place description; not measured on a map. Point is Herr Ridge at the pike, the likely last skirmish position.
k.say: S02: "Three squadrons, part dismounted, were ordered to the front, and deployed as skirmishers". S06: pickets "gradually fell back before us for about 3 miles"
k.notes: No source read so far names the ground the skirmishers held. A moving line; needs several timed points.

k.place: Right of Gamble's line, north of the railroad bed
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. lat/lon = north end; line_end = south end.
k.say: Map label: "3' Ind. Cav."
k.notes: Part of the P04 line. Whether this is the first line or the fall-back line is open (C05).

k.place: Between the railroad bed and the Chambersburg Pike
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. lat/lon = north end; line_end = south end.
k.say: Map label: "12' Ill. Cav."
k.notes: Part of the P04 line. Whether this is the first line or the fall-back line is open (C05).

k.place: South of the Chambersburg Pike
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. lat/lon = north end; line_end = south end.
k.say: Map label: "8' Ill. Cav."
k.notes: Part of the P04 line. The Gamble brigade tablet (S09) stands close to this bar. Whether this is the first line or the fall-back line is open (C05).

k.place: Left of Gamble's line, south of McPherson (Herbst) Woods
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. lat/lon = north end; line_end = south end.
k.say: Map label: "8' N.Y. Cav."
k.notes: Part of the P04 line. Bar is marked "Morning". Whether this is the first line or the fall-back line is open (C05).

k.place: Crest of the ridge on the right of Gamble, from the railroad bed north to the Mummasburg road
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. lat/lon = left flank; line_end = right flank, at the Mummasburg Road.
k.say: S03: "form on the crest of the hill on the right of the First Brigade", "my right resting on the road to Mummasburg"
k.notes: Time not given in S03; it follows the pickets being driven in. Map check: "Devin's Brigade ... Morning" is drawn as bars running north-north-east to the Mummasburg Road. Its left is about 390 m north of the 3rd Indiana's right, so the map leaves a gap between the two brigades. The brigade tablet (S10) stands about 140 m west of the map line.

k.place: One squadron deployed to join the skirmishers of the 1st Brigade
k.cb: Estimated by Claude from the place description; not measured on a map. Placed north of the pike beyond Willoughby Run.
k.say: "deployed a squadron of the Sixth New York to those of the First Brigade"
k.notes: Location relative to Gamble's skirmishers only.

k.place: Continuous line of skirmishers and vedettes across the three roads leading toward Carlisle, round to the York road on the extreme right
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. lat/lon = west end; line_end = east end, at the woods by Rock Creek. The line bends at 39.84354, -77.23251. Only the stretch the map draws; vedettes farther out on the roads are not shown.
k.say: "connecting by skirmishers and vedettes with my pickets on the three roads on the right leading toward Carlisle"; "York road, on the extreme right"
k.notes: Needs a line traced on a period map. Map check: a dotted line labelled "Skirmishers of Devin's Cavalry", marked "Morning", runs north of Pennsylvania College and then east-north-east to Rock Creek. The map does not say when in the morning.

k.place: On the Chambersburg Pike
k.cb: Crest at the pike: Buford memorial site (S15). The overnight position may have been behind it.
k.say: S08: arrived "in the evening from Emmitsburg" and took position on the Chambersburg Pike
k.notes: S17 says the overnight position was about 600 yards from the morning position.

k.place: On the Chambersburg Pike at the crest of McPherson Ridge
k.cb: Marker or tablet site coordinates (Historical Marker Database) (Buford memorial, S15)
k.say: S08: right and left sections on the Chambersburg Pike. S15: the "opening gun" was fired from this crest.
k.notes: Which side of the pike is not stated in the sources read.

tracks.name: Battery A, section under Sgt. Newman
tracks.label: Newman

k.place: On the Chambersburg Pike at the crest of McPherson Ridge, beside the other pike section
k.cb: Estimated by Claude from the place description; not measured on a map; offset slightly from P10
k.say: S08: two sections on the Chambersburg Pike
k.notes: Which sergeant held which section is in dispute (see Conflicts).

tracks.name: Battery A, section under Sgt. Pergel
tracks.label: Pergel

k.place: With the 1st Brigade south of McPherson (Herbst) Woods
k.cb: Marker or tablet site coordinates (Historical Marker Database) (tablet S08)
k.say: S08: section under "Sergt. Chas. Pergel" with the First Brigade, helped repulse an infantry attack, then withdrew
k.notes: S17 reports woods held by the enemy "within 200 yards of the right of the section", which led to its withdrawal.

k.place: On the Chambersburg Pike near Marsh Creek, about 3 miles from Gettysburg
k.cb: Estimated by Claude from the place description; not measured on a map (pike just west of the First Shot marker)
k.say: S07: "About 3 miles from Gettysburg, Heth's advance brigade (Archer's) encountered the advance of the enemy."
k.notes: S06 places first contact "about 3 miles" from camp instead (see Conflicts).

k.place: Herr Ridge, in sight of the enemy on a slight rise ahead and to the right of the road
k.cb: Derived: on the pike beside the map position of Marye's guns (P15). The halt itself is not drawn on the map.
k.say: S06: "General Archer halted for a short time while a section of a battery opened fire upon them."
k.notes: The map times Archer's line at 9 a.m., which leaves no room for a 9:00 to 9:30 halt. Times not changed; see C03.

k.place: Herr Ridge, on the right (south) of the turnpike
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. lat/lon = left flank (7th Tennessee, just south of the pike); line_end = right flank (1st Tennessee).
k.say: S04: "Archer's brigade in line of battle on the right of the turnpike". S06: "deployed the brigade in line, and advanced directly upon the enemy through an open field"
k.notes: Regiment order not given for 1 July. Line length is a guess. Map check: line labelled "Archer 9 A.M." starts about 185 m east of Herr Tavern and runs south-south-west about 660 m. The map says 9 a.m.; this row still says 09:30 (see C03).

k.place: Willoughby Run south of the pike, in front of Herbst (McPherson) Woods
k.cb: Estimated by Claude from the place description; not measured on a map. Tablet S11 stands just east at 39.83488, -77.25465.
k.say: S11: reached Willoughby Run about 10 a.m. S06: "a small creek with a fence and undergrowth"; "the brigade rushed across with a cheer"
k.notes: End of the pilot window: the brigade meets First Corps infantry just beyond the run.

k.place: Herr Ridge, south of the Chambersburg Pike
k.tb: As P17 (map label says 9 A.M.; see C03)
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. lat/lon = north end; line_end = south end.
k.say: Map label: "7' Tenn."
k.notes: Part of the P17 line. Left of the brigade, next to the pike.

k.place: Herr Ridge, south of the Chambersburg Pike
k.tb: As P17 (map label says 9 A.M.; see C03)
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. lat/lon = north end; line_end = south end.
k.say: Map label: "14' Tenn."
k.notes: Part of the P17 line.

k.place: Herr Ridge, south of the Chambersburg Pike
k.tb: As P17 (map label says 9 A.M.; see C03)
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. lat/lon = north end; line_end = south end.
k.say: Map label: "5' Ala. Batt'n"
k.notes: Part of the P17 line.

k.place: Herr Ridge, south of the Chambersburg Pike
k.tb: As P17 (map label says 9 A.M.; see C03)
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. lat/lon = north end; line_end = south end.
k.say: Map label: "13' Ala."
k.notes: Part of the P17 line. Label partly hidden by the woodland symbols.

k.place: Herr Ridge, south of the Chambersburg Pike
k.tb: As P17 (map label says 9 A.M.; see C03)
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. lat/lon = north end; line_end = south end.
k.say: Map label: "Tenn. (number hidden)"
k.notes: Part of the P17 line. Right of the brigade. Only "Tenn." is legible; taken as the 1st Tennessee because the 7th and 14th are labelled elsewhere in the line.

k.place: On the turnpike from Cashtown, in rear of Archer's brigade
k.cb: No coordinates: moving column
k.say: "I moved in rear of Archer's brigade, with three regiments of my command"

k.place: West of Herr's Tavern, on the left (north) of the turnpike with the right resting on it
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. lat/lon = right flank (42nd Mississippi, nearest the pike); line_end = left flank (55th North Carolina).
k.say: S05: "take position on the left of the turnpike, and with the right resting on it". S12: formed line west of Herr's Tavern
k.notes: S05 says the line formed "About 10.30 o'clock"; S12 says the brigade crossed the run about 10 a.m. Map check: line labelled "Davis 9 A.M." is drawn about 220 m east of Herr Tavern, not west of it as tablet S12 says (see C04). The map says 9 a.m.; this row still says 09:30 (see C03).

k.place: Willoughby Run north of the pike
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. Willoughby Run between the pike and the railroad bed.
k.say: S12: crossed the run about 10 a.m. S05: "the brigade moved forward about 1 mile, driving in the enemy's skirmishers"
k.notes: End of the pilot window. Map check: the map draws Davis's next line just east of the run here, from 39.83978, -77.25663 to 39.8411, -77.25538, and a line labelled 10.15 A.M. farther east (P37).

k.place: East of Willoughby Run and north of the railroad bed, facing Cutler's brigade
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. lat/lon = right end of the bar labelled 2nd Mississippi; line_end = left end of the bar labelled 55th North Carolina.
k.say: Map labels: "Davis Miss. 10.15 A.M.", "2' Miss.", "55' N.C."
k.notes: Snapshot at the end of the pilot window. A third bar to the south-west (39.83986, -77.2503 to 39.84058, -77.24966) is labelled only "Miss." and is probably the 42nd Mississippi; it is not included in the line.

k.place: Unfinished railroad cut north of the Chambersburg Pike, eastern arm of McPherson Ridge
k.tb: Outside the pilot window. The map gives these bars no time; the 95th New York beside them is labelled 10.30 A.M.
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. lat/lon = west end (42nd Mississippi); line_end = east end (2nd Mississippi).
k.say: Map labels: "42' Miss." and "2' Miss." along the cut
k.notes: Added to keep your P19 correction. Your point (39.838, -77.2483, credited to Gemini) is about 90 m from the east end of these bars, so the location holds up against the map. The time does not belong in the 7:30 to 10:15 window.

k.place: Right of Davis's line, next to the turnpike
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. lat/lon = south end; line_end = north end. Bar drawn between the pike and the railroad bed.
k.say: "with the Forty-second Mississippi ... on the right"
k.notes: Order in line is stated; the point is interpolated.

k.place: Centre of Davis's line
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. lat/lon = south end; line_end = north end. Bar drawn across the railroad bed.
k.say: "Second Mississippi ... in the center"

k.place: Left of Davis's line
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. lat/lon = south end; line_end = north end. Bar drawn north of the railroad bed.
k.say: "Fifty-fifth North Carolina ... on the left"

k.place: Ridge west of Herr's Tavern, near the south side of the Chambersburg Pike
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. Gun symbol on the Chambersburg Pike labelled "Opening Guns of the Battle. Marye's Art'y".
k.say: S04: "A few shot from Pegram's battalion (Marye's battery) scattered the cavalry vedettes." S05: "When within about 2 miles from town, our artillery was put in position"
k.notes: "Ridge west of Herr's Tavern" may mean Herr Ridge itself or the next ridge west. S06 mentions "a section of a battery". Map check: guns drawn on the pike about 290 m west-north-west of Herr Tavern.

k.place: Held in reserve behind Archer and Davis
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. Centre of four column symbols labelled "Pettigrew N.C."; no time label.
k.say: "Pettigrew's brigade and Heth's old brigade (Colonel Brockenbrough commanding), were held in reserve."
k.notes: Map check: drawn about 500 m south-west of Herr Tavern, behind Archer's line. The map does not time this symbol.

k.place: Held in reserve behind Archer and Davis
k.cb: Read from the Bachelder 1876 first-day map (S18), georeferenced; good to about 20-40 m. Centre of four column symbols labelled "Brockenbrough Va. (in Reserve)"; no time label.
k.say: As P26
k.notes: Map check: drawn about 200 m west of Herr Tavern, just south of the pike. The map does not time this symbol.

tracks.name: 11th Mississippi Infantry
tracks.label: 11 MS

k.place: With the division wagon train, near Cashtown
k.cb: Estimated by Claude from the place description; not measured on a map (Cashtown village); train position not stated
k.say: "the Eleventh Mississippi being left as a guard for the division wagon train"

tracks.offmap: With the division wagon train near Cashtown, about 8 miles west of Gettysburg.
